title: Donovan's conjecture over fields and complete mixed-characteristic DVRs

result.label: Donovan's conjecture over fields and complete mixed-characteristic DVRs
result.statement: Proves Donovan's conjecture: over each fixed algebraically closed field of characteristic p , blocks of finite groups with bounded defect-group order have only finitely many Morita-equivalence classes, for every prime p . Also proves the integral form over each fixed complete mixed-characteristic discrete valuation ring with algebraically closed residue field.
